trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] AND p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL RETURN p.position AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2 ORDER BY col1

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL WITH CASE WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'guard' THEN 'Backcourt' WHEN lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'forward' OR lower(p.position) CONTAINS 'center' THEN 'Frontcourt' ELSE NULL END AS position, CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS medals WHERE position IS NOT NULL RETURN position AS col1, MIN(medals) AS col2 ORDER BY col1
